description: Section 6 E4 (2026-11-17): every positive patron_support effect in the event catalog must be listed here, keyed by '<event id>#<option id>' or '<event id>#card', with the faction and a reason. A positive delta means the patron's material and political backing rises. The loader fails on an unlisted positive row (rule b). The list can never override rule (a): a positive patron_support for a faction on a row that also carries humanitarian_impact, a war_crimes_delta, a negative international_standing shift for that faction, or a Ring-3 family fails regardless. Pinned by tests/s6_e4_patron_support.test.ts. Round 3 (Q2) dropped abdic_apwb_declared_1993#federation_offer, hv_hvo_cooperation_1995#arbih_coordination and address_to_nation_rs#address_defiance_rs (no recorded patron change). Section 6 E3a2 (ruling items 4 and 6): the contact-group +10 moved from contact_group_plan_1994#accept to rbih_contact_group_response_1994#accept_51_49_plan, and rs_owen_stoltenberg_response_1993#accept_with_modifications lost its +5 (it is recorded as a refusal; a refusal's patron cost is the plan's -5).
